title:
Transform for `FetchResult<ReliabilityAsset>` for mapping `displayName` into the `assetImportanceLevel` field.
This is done so that the {@link UiSdlDataGrid} component can "natively" support sorting by `assetImportanceLevel` while displaying just `displayName` corresponding
to the importanceLevel.
name: UiSdlTransformReliabilityAssetImportanceFetchResult
